# govulncheck accepted-advisory allowlist
#
# One OSV/Go advisory ID per line. Anything govulncheck reports that is NOT
# listed here fails the gate, so this file narrows the gate, it never disables
# it. Every entry needs a reason and a tracking issue.
#
# Format: <GO-ID>  # <reason> (tracking: #<issue>)
#
# Removing an entry is part of closing its tracking issue.
#
# Enforced by .github/scripts/govuln-gate.sh, used by govuln.yml,
# security-scan.yml, deep-qa-block.yml and govulncheck-nightly.yml.
#
# ── Currently empty, and that is the goal. ───────────────────────────────
# The seven github.com/lib/pq advisories (GO-2026-6166, 6168, 6169, 6170,
# 6171, 6172, 6173) that lived here were removed when the CLI migrated to
# github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 and lib/pq left the dependency graph entirely
# (#232). govulncheck now reports "No vulnerabilities found".
#
# Prefer fixing or replacing the dependency over adding a line here. An entry
# is only justified when upstream ships no fix AND no alternative is viable;
# say so explicitly and link the issue that tracks removing it.
